Receptionist: Yes, but there is a management charge of 6 euros per night.
Carla: That charge did not appear in the quote I received by email.
Receptionist: It may have been added when the booking was closed.
Carla: I was not told there would be an extra charge. If I had known, I would have booked somewhere else.
Receptionist: I understand your annoyance. Would you like me to show you the booking details?
Carla: Yes, I want you to show me exactly where the charge appears.
Receptionist: I cannot change that now, because the charge is in the signed contract.
Carla: Then please check whether the charge was in the confirmation.
Receptionist: Here it is. It appears on page two, in small print.
Carla: That is not the same as telling me clearly. I want a copy of that page.
Receptionist: I will print it for you right now. Sorry for the confusion.
Carla: Thank you. I will keep the room, but I am keeping the copy in case I make a claim later.

5.speaking: You arrive at a hotel and find a management fee that was not in the quote you received. Say what you were told, ask which document includes the charge, and state what you would have done differently if you had known. Complication: the receptionist says the fee is in the contract you signed at the desk. Ask to see the clause and request a copy. Close by stating you accept the room but want the copy.
5.openingLine: Buenas tardes. Tiene una reserva a su nombre. ¿Viene a registrarse?
5.partnerRole: Hotel receptionist who explains a management fee and where it appears

grammar.focus: Me dijeron que habría describes past reported speech with the conditional for the future seen from the past. Si lo hubiera sabido introduces the pluperfect subjunctive in a hypothetical past.

examples.es: Me dijeron que habría un cargo de gestión.
examples.en: I was told there would be a management charge.

examples.es: Si lo hubiera sabido, habría reservado en otro sitio.
examples.en: If I had known, I would have booked somewhere else.

reading.title: Una retención que sigue activa
target: Elena: Buenas tardes. Llevo tres días esperando a que liberen la retención de 250 euros.
Recepción: Lo siento, todavía no aparece como liberada en nuestro sistema.
Elena: ¿Pueden confirmarme si el hotel envió la orden al banco?
Recepción: La enviamos el lunes, pero el banco tarda en procesarla.
Elena: Espero que la procesen pronto, porque tengo un pago importante el viernes.
Recepción: Lo entiendo. Puedo darle un justificante de la orden enviada.
Elena: Sí, por favor. Mi banco me pidió que lo enseñara.
Recepción: Aquí lo tiene: la orden se envió el lunes a las nueve.
Elena: Si el banco no la libera en tres días, ¿qué debo hacer?
Recepción: Llame a su banco con este número de referencia y pida que revisen la orden.
Elena: Gracias. Ojalá la retención se libere antes del viernes.
Recepción: Espero que así sea. Le avisamos si hay novedades.
native: Elena: Good afternoon. I have been waiting three days for the hold of 250 euros to be released.
Reception: I am sorry, it still does not appear as released in our system.
Elena: Can you confirm whether the hotel sent the order to the bank?
Reception: We sent it on Monday, but the bank takes time to process it.
Elena: I hope they process it soon, because I have an important payment on Friday.
Reception: I understand. I can give you a proof of the order sent.
Elena: Yes, please. My bank asked me to show it.
Reception: Here it is: the order was sent on Monday at nine.
Elena: If the bank does not release it in three days, what should I do?
Reception: Call your bank with this reference number and ask them to check the order.
Elena: Thank you. I hope the hold is released before Friday.
Reception: I hope so. We will let you know if there is news.

6.speaking: You have a hotel hold of 250 euros that you expected to be released after checkout, and you need the money before Friday. Ask whether the hotel has sent the release order, ask for proof, and agree on what to do if the bank still holds the amount on Wednesday. Complication: the receptionist says the system is offline and asks you to call the bank yourself. Accept the instruction, request the reference number and close by saying you will call tomorrow morning.
6.openingLine: Buenas tardes. ¿Viene por la retención de su tarjeta? Lo reviso ahora mismo.
6.partnerRole: Hotel receptionist who explains the release order and the bank timing

grammar.focus: Espero que followed by the present subjunctive expresses a hope about a future event. Pidió que with an imperfect subjunctive reports a past request.

examples.es: Espero que la procesen pronto.
examples.en: I hope they process it soon.

examples.es: Mi banco me pidió que lo enseñara.
examples.en: My bank asked me to show it.

reading.title: Un cargo del minibar que no reconozco
target: Héctor: Buenos días. Quiero revisar la factura, porque aparece un cargo de minibar.
Recepción: Sí, figura una bebida y un snack por 14 euros.
Héctor: No tomé nada del minibar. Ni siquiera abrí la puerta del frigorífico.
Recepción: El consumo se registró a las 23:00 en la habitación 14.
Héctor: Me gustaría que revisaran el registro de la habitación 14, por favor.
Recepción: Puedo pedir la revisión, aunque tardará un par de días.
Héctor: Quiero que se elimine el cargo mientras se revisa.
Recepción: No puedo eliminarlo sin autorización del gerente.
Héctor: Entonces, ¿quién autoriza la revisión?
Recepción: El gerente. Le pido que espere un momento, por favor.
Recepción: El gerente autoriza quitar el cargo de la factura mientras dura la revisión.
Héctor: Está bien. Quiero el resultado por escrito.
Recepción: Le enviaré el resultado por correo electrónico cuando termine la revisión.
native: Héctor: Good morning. I want to check the bill, because there is a minibar charge.
Reception: Yes, there is a drink and a snack for 14 euros.
Héctor: I did not take anything from the minibar. I did not even open the fridge door.
Reception: The consumption was recorded at 23:00 in room 14.
Héctor: I would like you to check the record for room 14, please.
Reception: I can request the review, although it will take a couple of days.
Héctor: I want the charge removed while it is being checked.
Reception: I cannot remove it without the manager's authorization.
Héctor: Then who authorizes the review?
Reception: The manager. Please wait a moment.
Reception: The manager authorizes removing the charge from the bill while the review is under way.
Héctor: Fine. I want the result in writing.
Reception: I will send you the result by email when the review is finished.

7.speaking: At checkout the bill includes a minibar charge for fourteen euros that you did not use. Identify the item, ask the time and room recorded, and request a review of the record. Complication: the receptionist says that only the manager can remove a charge. Ask who authorizes the review and request the result in writing. Close by thanking the staff and confirming how you will receive the outcome.
7.openingLine: Buenos días. ¿Quiere revisar la factura antes de pagar? La tiene aquí.
7.partnerRole: Hotel front-desk receptionist who handles charge disputes and the manager's review

grammar.focus: Me gustaría que takes the imperfect subjunctive: revisaran. Quiero que takes the present subjunctive: se elimine, passive se with no agent named.

examples.es: Me gustaría que revisaran el registro de la habitación.
examples.en: I would like you to check the room record.

examples.es: Quiero que se elimine el cargo mientras se revisa.
examples.en: I want the charge removed while it is checked.

reading.title: Un arañazo en el coche alquilado
target: Sergio: Buenas tardes. Me han cobrado 300 euros por un daño en la puerta del coche.
Empleada: Según el informe, se detectó un arañazo en la puerta trasera al devolverlo.
Sergio: No me avisaron de ningún daño cuando lo devolví. ¿Hay un registro de la inspección?
Empleada: Sí, tenemos fotos tomadas por el empleado de la entrega.
Sergio: Quiero que me enseñen la foto de la puerta trasera.
Empleada: Aquí está. La foto se tomó a las 19:00.
Sergio: Esa foto no muestra ningún arañazo claro, solo una sombra.
Empleada: Entiendo, pero el importe se basa en el informe firmado al devolverlo.
Sergio: Entonces quiero el desglose del importe y el nombre de quien firmó.
Empleada: Se lo envío con la referencia del alquiler.
Sergio: Presentaré una reclamación formal si no revisan el cargo.
Empleada: Tiene derecho a presentar esa reclamación por escrito.
native: Sergio: Good afternoon. I have been charged 300 euros for damage to the car door.
Clerk: According to the report, a scratch was detected on the rear door when it was returned.
Sergio: Nobody told me about any damage when I returned it. Is there a record of the inspection?
Clerk: Yes, we have photos taken by the employee at handover.
Sergio: I want you to show me the photo of the rear door.
Clerk: Here it is. The photo was taken at 19:00.
Sergio: That photo does not show any clear scratch, only a shadow.
Clerk: I understand, but the amount is based on the report signed at return.
Sergio: Then I want the breakdown of the amount and the name of the person who signed.
Clerk: I will send it to you with the rental reference.
Sergio: I will file a formal claim if they do not review the charge.
Clerk: You have the right to file that claim in writing.

8.speaking: At the rental counter you are charged 300 euros for a scratch on a rear door that you do not remember causing. Ask who made the inspection, request the photos and the itemized amount, and state that you dispute the charge. Complication: the agent says the photos are not available until next week. Ask for the written dispute process and the reference number. Close by stating you will file a formal claim if the charge is not reviewed.
8.openingLine: Buenas tardes. Dígame qué quiere revisar: el cargo por daños o la devolución del coche.
8.partnerRole: Rental-company agent who explains the inspection record and the dispute process

grammar.focus: Se detectó is passive se with a third-person verb: no agent is named. Quiero que me enseñen uses the present subjunctive for a demand for evidence.

examples.es: Se detectó un arañazo en la puerta trasera.
examples.en: A scratch was detected on the rear door.

examples.es: Quiero que me enseñen la foto de la puerta.
examples.en: I want you to show me the photo of the door.

reading.title: Una cotización que cambió
target: Olga: Buenas tardes. La cotización que recibí era de 180 euros por tres días, con el cargo por recogida incluido.
Agente: Sí, pero la nueva es de 355 euros: un modelo más grande, el seguro completo y el combustible prepagado.
Olga: Quiero distinguir lo obligatorio de lo opcional. ¿Qué cambió exactamente?
Agente: El cargo por recogida de 15 euros es obligatorio y ya estaba en los 180. Lo demás es opcional.
Olga: ¿Cuánto cuesta cada concepto por separado?
Agente: El modelo grande son 20 euros más al día, el seguro completo 25 euros al día y el combustible prepagado 40 euros.
Olga: ¿Cuánto sería sin el seguro completo?
Agente: Sin el seguro completo, el total sería 280 euros.
Olga: Entonces la cotización nueva incluye opciones que no pedí.
Agente: El cambio de modelo es automático en el sistema y no puedo quitarlo.
Olga: Si hubiera sabido lo del cambio, habría pedido el coche original por escrito.
Agente: Puede rechazar el combustible prepagado y devolver el coche con el depósito lleno.
Olga: Un cambio que no pedí no puede costarme más. Quiero la versión sin opciones adicionales.
Agente: Tiene razón: si no hay coche pequeño, el modelo grande va sin coste. Le imprimo la cotización revisada.
Olga: Perfecto. Firmo solo cuando la cotización diga 180 euros, con cada concepto separado.
native: Olga: Good afternoon. The quote I received was 180 euros for three days, with the pick-up fee included.
Agent: Yes, but the new one is 355 euros: a larger model, full insurance and prepaid fuel.
Olga: I want to separate what is required from what is optional. What exactly changed?
Agent: The 15-euro pick-up fee is required and was already in the 180. Everything else is optional.
Olga: How much does each item cost separately?
Agent: The larger model is 20 euros more per day, the full insurance 25 euros per day and the prepaid fuel 40 euros.
Olga: How much would it be without the full insurance?
Agent: Without the full insurance, the total would be 280 euros.
Olga: So the new quote includes options I did not ask for.
Agent: The model change is automatic in the system and I cannot remove it.
Olga: If I had known about the change, I would have asked for the original car in writing.
Agent: You can decline the prepaid fuel and return the car with a full tank.
Olga: A change I did not ask for cannot cost me more. I want the version without additional options.
Agent: You are right: if there is no small car, the larger model comes at no cost. I will print the revised quote for you.
Olga: Perfect. I will sign only when the quote says 180 euros, with each item listed separately.

9.speaking: The rental counter offers a larger car and extra insurance, and the total changes from the quote you received by email. Ask what changed, separate required fees from optional extras, and calculate what you would pay without the full insurance. Complication: the agent says the upgrade is automatic and cannot be removed. Ask for the cancellation terms in writing and request a revised quote without optional extras. Close by stating you will sign only when the quote is correct.
9.openingLine: Buenas tardes. ¿Viene a recoger el coche? Tengo una cotización nueva para usted.
9.partnerRole: Rental counter agent who explains upgrades, insurance and required fees

grammar.focus: Distinguir lo obligatorio de lo opcional contrasts two categories of charges. Si lo hubiera sabido introduces the pluperfect subjunctive in a hypothetical past.

examples.es: Si lo hubiera sabido, habría pedido el coche original.
examples.en: If I had known, I would have asked for the original car.

examples.es: Quiero distinguir lo obligatorio de lo opcional.
examples.en: I want to separate what is required from what is optional.

reading.title: Un pago que no coincide
target: Marta: Buenas noches. Acordamos 22 euros hasta el hotel, ¿verdad?
Conductor: Sí, pero con el peaje y la espera son 31 euros.
Marta: No es justo que cambie el precio sin avisarme.
Conductor: El peaje no estaba incluido en el acuerdo, y lo sabe.
Marta: Usted dijo que el precio era cerrado, sin extras.
Conductor: Bueno, la espera de cinco minutos también cuenta.
Marta: Quiero que me muestre el taxímetro y el peaje.
Conductor: El taxímetro marca 24 euros, más el peaje de 7 euros.
Marta: Entonces pago 22 euros y reviso el peaje con el recibo.
Conductor: No puedo aceptar eso. Necesito que me pague 31 euros.
Marta: Entonces quiero que llame a la central, para que lo confirmen.
Conductor: De acuerdo, llamo. La central confirma 22 euros más el peaje de 7: son 29 euros.
Marta: Bien. Pago 29 euros y guardo el recibo con la confirmación de la central.
Conductor: Aquí tiene el recibo con cada concepto: tarifa acordada y peaje.
native: Marta: Good evening. We agreed 22 euros to the hotel, right?
Driver: Yes, but with the toll and the waiting time it is 31 euros.
Marta: It is not fair for you to change the price without telling me.
Driver: The toll was not included in the agreement, and you know it.
Marta: You said the price was fixed, with no extras.
Driver: Well, the five-minute wait also counts.
Marta: I want you to show me the meter and the toll.
Driver: The meter shows 24 euros, plus the 7-euro toll.
Marta: Then I pay 22 euros and I check the toll with the receipt.
Driver: I cannot accept that. I need you to pay 31 euros.
Marta: Then I want you to call the central office, so that they confirm it.
Driver: All right, I will call. The central office confirms 22 euros plus the 7-euro toll: that is 29 euros.
Marta: Fine. I will pay 29 euros and keep the receipt with the central office's confirmation.
Driver: Here is the receipt with each item: agreed fare and toll.

10.speaking: You agreed a fare of 22 euros to the hotel, but the driver asks for 31 euros at arrival because of a toll and a waiting time. Ask what each extra is, ask to see the meter, and pay the agreed amount while you check the toll on the receipt. Complication: the driver refuses to accept the agreed amount and asks you to pay the full 31 euros now. Ask for the central office to confirm the fare. Close by saying you will keep the receipt and the fare confirmation.
10.openingLine: Buenas noches. Ya llegamos al hotel. Son 31 euros, con el peaje y la espera.
10.partnerRole: Taxi driver who asks for more than the agreed fare and explains the extras

grammar.focus: No es justo que with the subjunctive expresses a judgment on someone's action. Para que with the subjunctive states the purpose of a request for confirmation.

examples.es: No es justo que cambie el precio sin avisarme.
examples.en: It is not fair for you to change the price without telling me.

examples.es: Quiero que llame a la central, para que lo confirmen.
examples.en: I want you to call the central office, so that they can confirm it.

reading.title: Una cotización que cambió al final
target: Tomás: Buenos días. Según la cotización, me daban 184 euros por 200 dólares.
Cajera: Sí, pero el tipo cambió después de enviarle la cotización. Le doy 176 euros.
Tomás: ¿Cómo ha calculado esa cantidad? Quiero ver el tipo y la comisión.
Cajera: El tipo es 0,88 y no hay comisión, por eso sale 176 euros.
Tomás: Entonces la cotización inicial ya no es válida. ¿Cuándo cambió el tipo?
Cajera: Esta mañana. El sistema lo actualizó con la última revisión de tipos.
Tomás: No acepto ese cambio sin una explicación por escrito.
Cajera: Tiene que aceptarlo o cancelar la operación. Lo siento.
Tomás: Quiero que me den el tipo que aparecía en la cotización.
Cajera: No puedo hacerlo, el tipo se fija en el momento de la operación.
Tomás: Entonces cancelo la operación, y quiero que me devuelvan los dólares.
Cajera: Le devuelvo los 200 dólares ahora mismo. Lo siento mucho.
native: Tomás: Good morning. According to the quote, I was offered 184 euros for 200 dollars.
Cashier: Yes, but the rate changed after we sent you the quote. I will give you 176 euros.
Tomás: How did you calculate that amount? I want to see the rate and the fee.
Cashier: The rate is 0.88 and there is no fee, which is why it comes to 176 euros.
Tomás: So the first quote is no longer valid. When did the rate change?
Cashier: This morning. The system updated it with the latest rate review.
Tomás: I do not accept that change without a written explanation.
Cashier: You have to accept it or cancel the transaction. I am sorry.
Tomás: I want you to give me the rate that appeared on the quote.
Cashier: I cannot do it, the rate is set at the moment of the transaction.
Tomás: Then I cancel the transaction, and I want you to return the dollars to me.
Cashier: I return the 200 dollars to you right now. I am very sorry.

11.speaking: At an exchange counter, the cash offered is lower than the quote you saw by email. Ask how the amount was calculated, ask for the rate and the fee in writing, and decide whether to accept. Complication: the cashier says the system changed the rate at the last minute and the offer is final. Ask for the transaction to be cancelled and the dollars returned. Close by confirming you will not complete the exchange.
11.openingLine: Buenos días. ¿Quiere cambiar los 200 dólares hoy? Tengo la oferta lista.
11.partnerRole: Exchange-counter cashier who must explain a rate change made by the system

grammar.focus: Quiero que me den: querer que plus present subjunctive when another person acts. Cancelo is the present, used for a decision made now.

examples.es: Quiero que me den el tipo de la cotización.
examples.en: I want you to give me the rate from the quote.

examples.es: Entonces cancelo la operación.
examples.en: Then I cancel the transaction.

reading.title: Un retiro con conversión inesperada
target: Ana: Ayer retiré cien euros del cajero, pero el recibo muestra una conversión a dólares.
Empleado: ¿El cajero le preguntó en qué moneda quería que le cobraran el retiro?
Ana: Sí, pero la pantalla no decía que la conversión tuviera un coste extra.
Empleado: Es lo que llamamos conversión dinámica: el banco del cajero aplica su propio tipo.
Ana: Ojalá lo hubiera sabido antes de elegir.
Empleado: Ahora podemos revisar el recibo. Veo una comisión de cuatro euros y el tipo aplicado.
Ana: ¿Puede explicarme la diferencia entre el retiro, la comisión y la conversión?
Empleado: El retiro son 100 euros, la comisión del cajero son 4 euros, y la conversión pasó los 104 euros a dólares con el tipo del cajero.
Ana: Entonces el coste real fue mayor que el que la pantalla mostró.
Empleado: Sí. Por eso conviene comparar el tipo antes de aceptar la conversión.
Ana: Lo voy a recordar. ¿Me puede dar un papel con estas cifras?
Empleado: Claro, aquí tiene el desglose con cada cargo.
native: Ana: Yesterday I withdrew one hundred euros from the ATM, but the receipt shows a conversion to dollars.
Staff member: Did the ATM ask you which currency you wanted the withdrawal charged in?
Ana: Yes, but the screen did not say the conversion had an extra cost.
Staff member: It is what we call dynamic conversion: the ATM's bank applies its own rate.
Ana: I wish I had known before choosing.
Staff member: Now we can check the receipt. I see a fee of four euros and the rate applied.
Ana: Can you explain the difference between the withdrawal, the fee and the conversion?
Staff member: The withdrawal is 100 euros, the ATM fee is 4 euros, and the conversion turned the 104 euros into dollars at the ATM's rate.
Ana: So the real cost was higher than the screen showed.
Staff member: Yes. That is why it is advisable to compare the rate before accepting the conversion.
Ana: I will remember that. Can you give me a paper with these figures?
Staff member: Of course, here is the breakdown with each charge.

12.speaking: You withdrew cash abroad and the receipt shows a conversion you did not expect. Describe the withdrawal, ask what the fee and conversion are, and state what you would prefer next time. Complication: the bank employee says the conversion was chosen on the ATM screen and cannot be reversed. Ask for an explanation of the receipt in writing. Close by thanking the employee and saying you will keep the receipt.
12.openingLine: Buenas tardes. ¿Viene por un recibo de cajero que no entiende?
12.partnerRole: Bank employee who explains an ATM receipt and the dynamic conversion option

grammar.focus: Ojalá lo hubiera sabido uses the pluperfect subjunctive for a wish about the past. Conviene plus infinitive gives impersonal advice.

examples.es: Ojalá lo hubiera sabido antes de elegir.
examples.en: I wish I had known before choosing.

examples.es: Conviene comparar el tipo antes de aceptar la conversión.
examples.en: It is advisable to compare the rate before accepting the conversion.

reading.title: Un bolso con varias condiciones
target: Lucía: Buenas tardes. Me interesa este bolso, pero con algunas condiciones.
Vendedor: Dígame. ¿Cuántos quiere?
Lucía: Dos, si el precio total es razonable, y quiero la correa incluida.
Vendedor: Por dos, el precio es de 280 euros, sin correa.
Lucía: Si me los deja en 250 euros con la correa incluida, cierro hoy.
Vendedor: Con la correa, 260 euros es lo mejor que puedo hacer.
Lucía: Si acepta 255 euros, pago con tarjeta y me los envía al hotel sin coste.
Vendedor: El envío cuesta 5 euros: con correa y envío serían 265 euros.
Lucía: Entonces, 260 euros con envío incluido y cierro ahora. ¿En qué moneda cobra?
Vendedor: Vale, 260. Cobro en euros; si elige dólares en la terminal, la conversión usa nuestro tipo.
Lucía: Acepto 260 euros en euros, con envío al hotel.
Vendedor: Trato hecho. Le hago la factura con cada condición escrita.
native: Lucía: Good afternoon. I am interested in this bag, but with some conditions.
Seller: Tell me. How many do you want?
Lucía: Two, if the total price is reasonable, and I want the strap included.
Seller: For two, the price is 280 euros, without the strap.
Lucía: If you let me have them for 250 euros with the strap included, I will close the deal today.
Seller: With the strap, 260 euros is the best I can do.
Lucía: If you accept 255 euros, I will pay by card and you send them to the hotel at no cost.
Seller: Delivery costs 5 euros: with the strap and delivery it would be 265 euros.
Lucía: Then 260 euros with delivery included, and I close now. What currency do you charge in?
Seller: All right, 260. I charge in euros; if you choose dollars on the terminal, the conversion uses our rate.
Lucía: I accept 260 euros in euros, with delivery to the hotel.
Seller: Deal. I will make the invoice with each condition written down.

13.speaking: At a leather goods shop, you want two bags, the strap included and delivery to your hotel, and you are willing to pay at a specific total. Set your conditions one by one, agree the final price and the currency, and confirm the delivery. Complication: the seller says delivery costs extra and the price rises. Decide whether the new total still works for you. Close by saying you accept at the agreed total.
13.openingLine: Buenas tardes. ¿Le interesa algo en particular? Tenemos bolsos de piel recién llegados.
13.partnerRole: Shop owner in a leather goods store who negotiates a multi-item sale

grammar.focus: Si with a present verb introduces a real condition, followed by a present or future result. In me los deja, me is the buyer and los the two bags; both go before the conjugated verb.

examples.es: Si me los deja en 250 euros, cierro hoy.
examples.en: If you let me have them for 250 euros, I will close the deal today.

examples.es: Si acepta 255 euros, pago con tarjeta.
examples.en: If you accept 255 euros, I pay by card.

reading.title: Un reembolso parcial de la excursión
target: Nadia: Buenas tardes. Cancelé el tour de la semana pasada y quiero el reembolso.
Agente: Según las condiciones, devolvemos el importe menos un cargo de gestión.
Nadia: ¿De cuánto es ese cargo? Pagué 150 euros.
Agente: El cargo es de 30 euros. Le devolvemos 120 euros.
Nadia: No acepto el cargo a menos que esté en las condiciones firmadas.
Agente: Está en el apartado de cancelaciones, al final de la página.
Nadia: Entonces, ¿en qué moneda y por qué vía me devuelven el dinero?
Agente: En euros, a la misma tarjeta que usó para pagar, salvo que prefiera transferencia.
Nadia: Prefiero la tarjeta, siempre que tarden menos de diez días.
Agente: Tardará unos cinco días hábiles, pero no puedo garantizar el plazo.
Nadia: De acuerdo. Quiero el reembolso parcial por escrito, con la cifra exacta.
Agente: Se lo envío hoy, con la referencia de la cancelación.
native: Nadia: Good afternoon. I cancelled the tour last week and I want the refund.
Agent: According to the terms, we refund the amount minus a management fee.
Nadia: How much is that fee? I paid 150 euros.
Agent: The fee is 30 euros. We refund you 120 euros.
Nadia: I do not accept the fee unless it is in the signed terms.
Agent: It is in the cancellations section, at the end of the page.
Nadia: Then, in what currency and by what route do you return the money to me?
Agent: In euros, to the same card you used to pay, unless you prefer a transfer.
Nadia: I prefer the card, as long as they take less than ten days.
Agent: It will take about five business days, but I cannot guarantee the timing.
Nadia: Agreed. I want the partial refund in writing, with the exact figure.
Agent: I will send it to you today, with the cancellation reference.

14.speaking: You cancelled a paid day tour and want part of the money back. Ask how much will be refunded, what fee is kept, and whether the refund goes to your card. Complication: the agent says the refund will take ten days and the fee is not in writing. Ask for the terms to be shown, and agree only if the figure is confirmed in writing. Close by thanking the agent and requesting the written figure.
14.openingLine: Buenas tardes. ¿Viene por la cancelación de su excursión? Lo reviso ahora.
14.partnerRole: Tour company agent who explains partial refunds and the retained fee

grammar.focus: A menos que and siempre que take the subjunctive because they describe conditions that may not be met. Menos introduces the amount deducted from a total.

examples.es: No acepto el cargo a menos que esté en las condiciones.
examples.en: I do not accept the fee unless it is in the terms.

examples.es: Prefiero la tarjeta, siempre que tarden menos de diez días.
examples.en: I prefer the card, as long as they take less than ten days.

reading.title: Cancelar una reserva pagada
target: Julián: Quiero cancelar mi reserva prepagada de un hostal para el 3 de marzo.
Agente: Revisemos las condiciones escritas. ¿Cuál es el número de reserva?
Julián: Es el número 7741 y pagué 360 euros. ¿Cuánto me devuelven si cancelo ahora?
Agente: Según las condiciones, si cancela con más de 14 días, se devuelve el total.
Julián: Estoy a 12 días de la fecha. ¿Qué ocurre entonces?
Agente: Entonces se devuelve el 50 por ciento del importe pagado.
Julián: Tengo el documento firmado aquí. El apartado tres dice que entre 7 y 14 días se devuelve el 75 por ciento.
Agente: Tiene razón. Déjeme revisar esa cláusula, por favor.
Agente: Sí, vale el documento firmado: se devuelve el 75 por ciento del importe.
Julián: Quiero que me confirme cuánto recibiré, en euros y con la fecha.
Agente: Recibirá 270 euros, y el reembolso llegará en diez días.
Julián: Entonces cancelo, pero quiero el importe por escrito.
Agente: Hecho. Le envío la cancelación con el número de confirmación.
native: Julián: I want to cancel my prepaid guesthouse booking for 3 March.
Agent: Let us review the written terms. What is the booking number?
Julián: It is number 7741 and I paid 360 euros. How much do you return to me if I cancel now?
Agent: According to the terms, if you cancel more than 14 days ahead, the total is returned.
Julián: I am 12 days from the date. What happens then?
Agent: Then 50 percent of the amount paid is returned.
Julián: I have the signed document here. Section three says that between 7 and 14 days, 75 percent is returned.
Agent: You are right. Let me check that clause, please.
Agent: Yes, the signed document applies: 75 percent of the amount is returned.
Julián: I want you to confirm how much I will receive, in euros and with the date.
Agent: You will receive 270 euros, and the refund will arrive in ten days.
Julián: Then I cancel, but I want the amount in writing.
Agent: Done. I will send you the cancellation with the confirmation number.

15.speaking: You have a prepaid guesthouse booking for March and need to cancel it. Read the cancellation clause from the written terms, state how many days remain before arrival, and ask what refund you receive. Complication: the receptionist says the signed document shows a different percentage on section three. Ask for the section to be reviewed and confirm the final amount. Close by requesting written confirmation of the cancellation.
15.openingLine: Buenas tardes. ¿Quiere cancelar una reserva? Dígame el número, por favor.
15.partnerRole: Guesthouse reservations agent who checks the written cancellation terms

grammar.focus: Si cancela with the present introduces a condition that leads to a refund result. Recibirá is the future tense of recibir, used for an expected payment.

examples.es: Si cancela con más de 14 días, se devuelve el total.
examples.en: If you cancel more than 14 days ahead, the total is returned.

examples.es: Recibirá 270 euros, y el reembolso llegará en diez días.
examples.en: You will receive 270 euros, and the refund will arrive in ten days.

reading.title: Crédito en la aplicación o dinero
target: Sofía: Hola, la aplicación me ofrece un crédito de 45 euros en lugar del reembolso.
Soporte: Sí, el crédito se puede usar en cualquier reserva de la plataforma.
Sofía: Quiero que el reembolso vaya a mi tarjeta, en dinero y no en crédito.
Soporte: Lo siento, el reembolso a la tarjeta solo se aplica a pagos de más de cien euros.
Sofía: Mi pago fue de 45 euros con tarjeta, así que no entra en esa regla, ¿verdad?
Soporte: Correcto. El crédito caduca en un año y no es transferible.
Sofía: ¿Y si no lo uso antes de esa fecha, lo pierdo?
Soporte: Sí, se pierde si no se aplica antes del vencimiento.
Sofía: Entonces prefiero que me devuelvan el dinero, aunque tarde unos días.
Soporte: Lo entiendo. Puedo registrar la solicitud de reembolso, pero no garantizo el plazo.
Sofía: De acuerdo. ¿Me envían la confirmación por correo, por favor?
Soporte: Sí, en cuanto la solicitud quede registrada.
native: Sofía: Hello, the app offers me a credit of 45 euros instead of a refund.
Support: Yes, the credit can be used for any booking on the platform.
Sofía: I want the refund to go to my card, as money and not as credit.
Support: I am sorry, the refund to the card only applies to payments of more than one hundred euros.
Sofía: My payment was 45 euros by card, so it does not fall under that rule, right?
Support: Correct. The credit expires in one year and is not transferable.
Sofía: And if I do not use it before that date, do I lose it?
Support: Yes, it is lost if it is not applied before the expiry.
Sofía: Then I prefer that they return the money to me, even if it takes a few days.
Support: I understand. I can register the refund request, but I do not guarantee the timing.
Sofía: Agreed. Can you send the confirmation to me by email, please?
Support: Yes, as soon as the request is registered.

16.speaking: The travel app offers you a 45-euro credit instead of a cash refund. Ask whether the refund can be paid to your card, what restrictions the credit has, and when it expires. Complication: the support agent says a refund to the card is only for payments above one hundred euros. Ask whether your case can be submitted as a refund request anyway, and request confirmation by email. Close by stating which option you accept.
16.openingLine: Hola, bienvenida al soporte. ¿Tiene un problema con un reembolso de la aplicación?
16.partnerRole: Travel-app customer support agent who explains credits and refund rules

grammar.focus: Quiero que el reembolso vaya: querer que plus subjunctive when the subject changes. Caduca: the present can state a future rule.

examples.es: Quiero que el reembolso vaya a mi tarjeta.
examples.en: I want the refund to go to my card.

examples.es: El crédito caduca en un año.
examples.en: The credit expires in one year.

reading.title: Una cartera perdida en el tren
target: Iván: Perdone, he perdido la cartera en el tren y tengo dos tarjetas dentro.
Empleado: Lo siento mucho. ¿Quiere llamar ahora a su banco para bloquear las tarjetas?
Iván: Sí. Necesito que el banco bloquee la tarjeta de crédito y la de débito.
Empleado: Puede llamar al número de su banco. Si no lo tiene, lo busco aquí.
Iván: Ya lo tengo en el móvil, pero ¿qué pasa con el dinero de la cuenta?
Empleado: Mientras no bloquee las tarjetas, alguien podría usarlas para pagos sin contacto o por internet.
Iván: ¿Puede comprobar si alguien ha usado la tarjeta desde que la perdí?
Empleado: No puedo ver su cuenta, pero su banco sí. Le recomiendo que lo llame cuanto antes.
Iván: Ya he llamado y han bloqueado las dos tarjetas.
Empleado: Muy bien. Si el banco pide una denuncia, tiene que denunciar la pérdida en la comisaría más cercana.
Iván: Sí, la pide. Entonces pediré al banco que me envíe la nueva tarjeta al hotel de la ciudad.
Empleado: La comisaría está a dos calles; allí le dan un justificante de la denuncia para el banco.
native: Iván: Excuse me, I have lost my wallet on the train, and I have two cards inside it.
Staff member: I am very sorry. Do you want to call your bank now to block the cards?
Iván: Yes. I need the bank to block the credit card and the debit card.
Staff member: You can call your bank's number. If you do not have it, I will look for it here.
Iván: I already have it on my phone, but what happens to the money in the account?
Staff member: Until you block the cards, someone could use them for contactless or online payments.
Iván: Can you check whether anyone has used the card since I lost it?
Staff member: I cannot see your account, but your bank can. I recommend you call them as soon as possible.
Iván: I have already called and they have blocked both cards.
Staff member: Very well. If the bank asks for a police report, you have to report the loss at the nearest police station.
Iván: Yes, it does. Then I will ask the bank to send the new card to the hotel in the city.
Staff member: The police station is two streets away; there they give you proof of the report for the bank.

17.speaking: You lost your wallet on a train and it contained two cards. Report the loss to the station staff, ask for help contacting your bank to block both cards, and ask what risk remains until they are blocked. Complication: the bank requires a police report before sending the new card. Ask where the nearest police station is and how to make the report. Close by confirming the address to which the new card should be sent.
17.openingLine: Buenas tardes. ¿Qué le pasa? Parece que está preocupado.
17.partnerRole: Station staff member who helps a traveller report a lost wallet

grammar.focus: He perdido uses haber in the present with a participle for a recent loss. Necesito que bloqueen and mientras no bloquee use the subjunctive after a need and a time condition.

examples.es: He perdido la cartera en el tren.
examples.en: I have lost my wallet on the train.

examples.es: Necesito que bloqueen la tarjeta de crédito.
examples.en: I need you to block the credit card.

reading.title: Un plan de pagos para la excursión
target: Rosa: Buenas tardes. El total de la excursión son 480 euros, ¿verdad?
Agente: Sí, aunque el pago completo se hace antes de salir.
Rosa: ¿Sería posible pagar la mitad hoy y el resto en dos semanas?
Agente: Podemos aceptar un pago parcial de 240 euros hoy.
Rosa: Y el resto, 240 euros, lo pagaría con tarjeta en la fecha que indique.
Agente: Lo anotamos. El saldo vence el 20 de junio.
Rosa: ¿Y si pago una parte en efectivo y otra con tarjeta hoy mismo?
Agente: Puede dividirlo, pero el efectivo debe cubrir al menos 100 euros.
Rosa: Entonces pago 100 euros en efectivo y 140 con tarjeta.
Agente: Perfecto. Le hago el recibo con dos apuntes, uno por cada método.
Rosa: Quiero que el saldo aparezca en la factura, con la fecha.
Agente: Por supuesto. Le envío la factura con el importe pendiente.
native: Rosa: Good afternoon. The total for the day trip is 480 euros, right?
Agent: Yes, although the full payment is made before departure.
Rosa: Would it be possible to pay half today and the rest in two weeks?
Agent: We can accept a partial payment of 240 euros today.
Rosa: And I would pay the rest, 240 euros, by card on the date you indicate.
Agent: We will note it down. The balance is due on 20 June.
Rosa: And if I pay one part in cash and another by card today?
Agent: You can split it, but the cash must cover at least 100 euros.
Rosa: Then I pay 100 euros in cash and 140 by card.
Agent: Perfect. I will make the receipt with two entries, one for each method.
Rosa: I want the balance to appear on the invoice, with the date.
Agent: Of course. I will send you the invoice with the outstanding amount.

18.speaking: You booked a day trip for 480 euros and want to pay half now and half later, split between cash and card. Ask whether a partial payment is possible, how the balance is recorded, and whether the invoice shows the outstanding amount. Complication: the agent says the minimum cash part is 100 euros. Agree to a split that meets the minimum and request the invoice with the balance clearly shown. Close by confirming the payment plan.
18.openingLine: Buenas tardes. ¿Viene a confirmar el pago de la excursión? Dígame.
18.partnerRole: Tour-operator agent who accepts a partial payment plan with conditions

grammar.focus: Sería posible uses the conditional for a polite question. Pagaría with the conditional expresses a planned payment that depends on the situation.

examples.es: ¿Sería posible pagar la mitad hoy?
examples.en: Would it be possible to pay half today?

examples.es: Lo pagaría con tarjeta en la fecha que indique.
examples.en: I would pay it by card on the date you indicate.

reading.title: Cuánto recibimos al cambiar
target: Ana: Quiero entender cuánto recibimos si cambiamos 300 euros a dólares.
Luis: El tipo es 1,08 dólares por euro, así que por cada euro recibimos 1,08 dólares.
Ana: Entonces 300 euros por 1,08 son 324 dólares, ¿no?
Luis: Exacto. Eso es lo que sale sin comisión.
Ana: ¿Y si la casa cobra 2 euros de comisión?
Luis: Entonces restamos antes de convertir: 298 euros por 1,08 son 321,84 dólares.
Ana: Es decir, la comisión nos cuesta unos dos dólares y pico.
Luis: Sí: 324 menos 321,84 son 2,16 dólares de diferencia.
Ana: Por eso conviene comparar el importe final, no solo el tipo.
Luis: Exacto: una oferta con mejor tipo puede dar menos dinero si cobra más comisión.
Ana: Entonces calculamos siempre con 300 euros de referencia para comparar.
Luis: De acuerdo. Así sabemos el resultado final con cada casa de cambio.
native: Ana: I want to understand how much we receive if we change 300 euros into dollars.
Luis: The rate is 1.08 dollars per euro, so for each euro we receive 1.08 dollars.
Ana: So 300 euros at 1.08 is 324 dollars, right?
Luis: Exactly. That is what comes out without a fee.
Ana: And if the office charges a 2-euro fee?
Luis: Then we subtract before converting: 298 euros at 1.08 is 321.84 dollars.
Ana: That is to say, the fee costs us about two dollars and a bit.
Luis: Yes: 324 minus 321.84 is a difference of 2.16 dollars.
Ana: That is why it is advisable to compare the final amount, not only the rate.
Luis: Exactly: an offer with a better rate can give less money if it charges a higher fee.
Ana: Then we always calculate with 300 euros as a reference to compare.
Luis: Agreed. That way we know the final result at each exchange office.

19.speaking: You and a companion want to know how many dollars 300 euros will become after a 2-euro fee, at a rate of 1.08 dollars per euro. Explain the rate per unit, subtract the fee first, calculate the final amount, and state the difference between this offer and the one without a fee. Complication: your companion says the other exchange office has a better rate, so you must compare final amounts, not just rates. Close by agreeing to compare the final amounts at each office.
19.openingLine: Quiero entender cuánto recibimos si cambiamos 300 euros. Explícamelo paso a paso.
19.partnerRole: Travelling companion who asks how the exchange calculation works

grammar.focus: Por cada expresses a rate per unit, as in por cada euro recibimos 1,08 dólares. Es decir restates a conclusion in other words.

examples.es: Por cada euro recibimos 1,08 dólares.
examples.en: For each euro we receive 1.08 dollars.

examples.es: Es decir, la comisión nos cuesta unos dos dólares.
examples.en: That is to say, the fee costs us about two dollars.

reading.title: Un caso de pagos complicado
target: Mónica: Buenas noches. Tengo una retención del hotel de 200 euros en mi tarjeta.
Recepción: La liberamos hoy al cerrar su cuenta; su banco puede tardar unos días hábiles en mostrarla.
Mónica: Espero que la liberen antes del lunes, porque viajo.
Recepción: Le daré el justificante de la liberación con la referencia.
Mónica: Gracias. Ya en el taxi a la estación, el conductor me pide 19 euros, no los 15 acordados.
Conductor: Hay obras en la avenida y he tenido que dar un rodeo.
Mónica: No es justo que cambie el precio sin avisarme. Quiero que me muestre el recibo.
Conductor: Aquí lo tiene: 15 euros de tarifa y 4 de suplemento por obras.
Mónica: Pago los 19 euros, pero guardo el recibo y reclamo el suplemento a la empresa de taxis.
Cajera: Buenas tardes. ¿Quiere cambiar los 100 dólares que le quedan? Hoy tenemos un tipo nuevo.
Mónica: La cotización decía 92 euros, pero ahora me ofrece 89 euros.
Cajera: Es el tipo de hoy, 0,90 euros por dólar, menos una comisión de 1 euro: 89 euros.
Mónica: Quiero el cálculo por escrito antes de aceptar.
Mónica: Con el cálculo escrito, acepto los 89 euros y guardo el papel con los otros recibos.
Mónica: Resumen del día: 200 euros retenidos, 19 pagados en el taxi con 4 en reclamación, y 89 euros recibidos.
native: Mónica: Good evening. I have a 200-euro hold from the hotel on my card.
Reception: We release it today when we close your bill; your bank may take a few business days to show it.
Mónica: I hope they release it before Monday, because I am travelling.
Reception: I will give you the proof of the release with the reference.
Mónica: Thank you. Later, in the taxi to the station, the driver asks me for 19 euros, not the agreed 15.
Driver: There are roadworks on the avenue and I had to take a detour.
Mónica: It is not fair for you to change the price without telling me. I want you to show me the receipt.
Driver: Here it is: 15 euros of fare and 4 of supplement for roadworks.
Mónica: I will pay the 19 euros, but I am keeping the receipt and disputing the supplement with the taxi company.
Cashier: Good afternoon. Do you want to change the 100 dollars you have left? Today we have a new rate.
Mónica: The quote said 92 euros, but now you offer me 89 euros.
Cashier: It is today's rate, 0.90 euros per dollar, minus a 1-euro fee: 89 euros.
Mónica: I want the calculation in writing before I accept.
Mónica: With the written calculation, I accept the 89 euros and keep the paper with the other receipts.
Mónica: Summary of the day: 200 euros on hold, 19 paid for the taxi with 4 under dispute, and 89 euros received.

20.speaking: At a hotel, you have a 200-euro hold, a taxi that charged more than the agreed fare, and an exchange offer that gave less than the quote. Explain each problem in order: the hold first, then the taxi, then the exchange. Ask for the evidence for each, decide what you will pay now, and agree which item to dispute later. Complication: the exchange office says the quote is final and the taxi driver is no longer available. Ask for a written statement for each item and close by stating your total and the receipts you will keep.
20.openingLine: Buenas noches. Veo que tiene varios temas pendientes. ¿Por cuál empezamos?
20.partnerRole: Hotel receptionist who helps a traveller sort out holds, a taxi dispute and an exchange quote

grammar.focus: Esperamos que and espero que take the subjunctive for hopes about another party's action. Quiero plus a noun names the thing wanted (quiero el cálculo). Use quiero plus infinitive for your own action (quiero revisar el cálculo), and quiero que plus subjunctive for another person's action.

examples.es: Espero que la liberen antes del lunes.
examples.en: I hope they release it before Monday.

examples.es: Quiero el cálculo por escrito antes de aceptar.
examples.en: I want the calculation in writing before I accept.
